recommendation_before_coding.1_window_above_floor: A plan-cut WINDOW occurrence is never a floor opening by itself. Represent it as a FLOOR_CONTACT classification of the hosting wall span: PLAN_OPENING + VERTICAL EVIDENCE -> WINDOW_ABOVE_FLOOR (wall below: skirting continues) / FULL_HEIGHT_FLOOR_OPENING (path breaks) / FLOOR_CONTACT_UNPROVEN (span withheld). Vertical evidence: a source sill / schedule / section first; else a scoped owner fact. The plan convention (the wall face line drawn continuous across the opening) is corroboration of a sill, never alone the authority.
recommendation_before_coding.2_trade_only_continuity_segment: YES: SKIRTING_CONTINUITY_UNDER_WINDOW is a TRADE measurement span on the hosting wall face (host wall, window occurrence, span, sill authority), carried by the skirting measurement only. It never enters TS01, never becomes a topology closure, never changes a site or a digest of the topology layer.
recommendation_before_coding.3_supersedes_qp09: YES for the current selected Qortuba region only (scoped supersession QORTUBA-NEW-SKIRTING-WINDOW-FLOOR-CONTACT-OWNER-001@v1); QP-09 stays on file, unchanged, for its own scope (old revision / history).
recommendation_before_coding.4_door_vs_doorless: DOOR_PRESENT = a proven door occurrence (leaf / swing symbol) hosting the opening: the threshold strip between its face closures is a separate site; skirting stops at the opening edge, zero across, zero in the jambs. DOORLESS_OPENING = an OPEN_PASSAGE_SITE (no leaf, frame-only or bare): zero across the clear width, but its real floor-level side jambs carry skirting.
recommendation_before_coding.5_door_jamb_zero: YES, by explicit owner authority now (URBAN-SKIRTING-OPENING-METHOD@v1 DOOR_PRESENT: STOP_AT_OPENING, JAMB_SKIRTING = NONE). JAMB_RETURN_METHOD_INFERRED disappears for doors. Plaster on the same jambs stays possible and independent.
recommendation_before_coding.6_doorless_jamb_surfaces: Only the passage strip's two SHORT sides (length = wall thickness), each counted once, when it is a real vertical surface: (a) a drawn admitted cap across a band end, or (b) the end of an ESTABLISHED wall band whose two faces end flush on that line (a physical wall end). A short side that is the continuous face of another wall is wall path already (not a jamb). The opening width itself is zero.
recommendation_before_coding.7_hall_far_jamb: From the wall-band evidence, not the closure: the passage target BANDEND|WB-6c88|0 names an ESTABLISHED band whose faces end flush at the jamb line - the jamb record takes its length from those face end points (200 mm), its authority from the band (owner REAL_WALL_END H2431 corroborating). The TOPOLOGY_CLOSURE edge on that line stays zero material and zero skirting; it only locates the jamb.
recommendation_before_coding.8_i1471_evidence: A proven door occurrence (leaf + swing) with closure A; both A hits are straight jamb caps of two ESTABLISHED wall bands, perpendicular to A; both caps share ONE far line parallel to A (the flush HALL-side faces), at equal depth t; the near-side stagger (50 mm) is no deeper than t; B has A's length and direction; no admitted segment crosses the strip interior; exactly one far side qualifies (no competing candidate).
recommendation_before_coding.9_version_and_freeze: YES: it changes TS01 sites (a new OPENING_SITE; HALL shrinks by the strip) - DOOR_OPENING_CLOSURE_POLICY_V2 (V1 = the R8.9 end-point rule, now named), recorded in the run manifest so the TOPOLOGY digest changes for exactly that reason; synthetic tests -> freeze -> commit -> blind Qortuba run -> commit -> compare. WALL_BAND_POLICY_V5 and TOPOLOGY_CLOSURE_POLICY_V1 stay unchanged.
recommendation_before_coding.10_scope: Stay focused: closure B + skirting V3 + hidden profile + Q-14 / floor regression this round. The wall-face engine (plaster / paint / 3.20 m tile) gets a design + readiness assessment only: it needs face-set geometry per room side, opening heights per opening, the US-06 deductions and the reveal adds - each a frozen, blind-tested step of its own.
11_disagreements_with_chatgpt: The HALL / PAINTRY 2.75 m glazed opening is not proven to be a 'normal window': it has no wall line across it, and QP-12 gives a 2.20 m HEIGHT (door-like), not a sill. Applying the 1.00 m owner fact to it would be a guess - its span is FLOOR_CONTACT_UNPROVEN (withheld, one owner question prepared), not continuity.

Plan convention (wall line drawn across a window) is corroboration, not authority: the owner's scoped sill fact is the authority here; another project's plan convention alone must not create skirting.
A doorless 'right jamb' does not always exist: at M.B.ROOM / DRESS the passage ends on the continuous face of H518 - that is wall path, and counting it again as a jamb would double count.
The closure fix is a TOPOLOGY change, not a trade patch: the strip must become a TS01 OPENING_SITE (so floor, ceiling and marble all see it), not a ceiling deduction in the trade layer.
Door-jamb plaster and door-jamb skirting must be decoupled: zero skirting does not mean zero reveal surface.
